name: const unsafe fn as_mut < 'a > (self) -> Option < & 'a mut T >
rule: When calling `as_mut` with a non-null pointer, the pointed-to value must be initialized; if it may be uninitialized, `as_uninit_mut` must be used instead.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > * mut T { const unsafe fn as_mut < 'a > (self) -> core::option::Option < & 'a mut T > }
